points.quote: `packages/backend/` has `server` (NestJS) and `native`... `packages/common/` is shared code... `packages/frontend/` is the client side
**`tests/`** holds end-to-end tests. **`tools/`** has the CLI and CI helpers.
**`blocksuite/`** is the editor, a separate sub-monorepo.
Web app (`apps/web`) - Admin panel (`frontend/admin`) - Desktop app (Electron...) - Mobile app (`apps/mobile`) - iOS (`apps/ios`) and Android (`apps/android`) apps
`native` (the Rust bindings used by the server)... `electron-api`, `native` and `mobile-native` bridge to native code.
It is what makes the self-hosted or cloud version work. The local-first clients can work without it.
**PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension.** ... **Redis.** ... exposes GraphQL (Apollo) and REST
